scope: A first count computed by one T=MAD/XOR/AND/OR from the eight initial words and arbitrary root constants, used as the sole SHR count. Numerator and all remaining computation may be arbitrary-length T expressions, with all bypasses retained.
proof: Each eight-point fibre has fixed T-prefix/suffix low3 and eight distinct target low3 values. Therefore all q low3 values must be distinct, so at most one count may clamp to0. The finite screen proves every first-T count satisfying this condition and the universal band is constant on the probe set. Separate QF_BV queries quantify over all full32 b/root parameters and prove finite constancy implies full32 constancy for every count wiring. A constant count cannot clamp, so it lies in16..23.
